title: Add all infra devDependencies and npm scripts in one commit (single writer of package.json and lockfile)
acceptance: npm ci && npm test && npm run build all pass; npm ls vite-plugin-pwa workbox-window @playwright/test eslint eslint-plugin-react-hooks @vite-pwa/assets-generator lists the pinned versions; npx playwright --version prints 1.63.0; scripts lint, test:e2e, build:e2e, preview:e2e, icons, size exist in package.json.
notes: Pins: vite-plugin-pwa 2.0.0, workbox-window 7.4.1, @vite-pwa/assets-generator 1.0.2, @playwright/test 1.63.0, eslint 10.14.0, @eslint/js 10.0.1, globals 17.14.0, eslint-plugin-react-hooks 7.1.1. Synthesis must chain after X1-02 (router, engines) and any other package.json writer; X1-03 duplicates this task.

title: Create the Forge icon source SVG and generate the PNG icon set reproducibly
acceptance: npm run icons produces public/icons/pwa-192x192.png, pwa-512x512.png, maskable-icon-512x512.png, apple-touch-icon-180x180.png, favicon.ico and favicon.svg; `file public/icons/*.png` shows 192x192, 512x512, 512x512 and 180x180; sha256sum of public/icons/* is identical after a second npm run icons.
notes: Background #0a0c10; maskable content kept inside the central 80 percent. Overlaps X1-04. First version is a plain vector flame; the user may replace the SVG later (R7-03).

title: USER: approve or supply the Forge icon artwork and confirm the icon background colour
acceptance: User confirms the flame artwork and #0a0c10 background, or replaces assets/icon-source.svg; if replaced, npm run icons is re-run and the PNGs are committed.
notes: User-only action; blocks nothing technical, so P1 can ship with the first-version icon.

title: Configure vite-plugin-pwa (generateSW), manifest and index.html icon links, plus a check-sw build verifier
acceptance: npm run build emits dist/sw.js and dist/workbox-*.js; node scripts/ci/check-sw.mjs exits 0, asserting the precache list contains index.html and icons but not dsa/ or puzzles.json, the navigate denylist covers /api/ and /dsa/, and /api/ and *.supabase.co use NetworkOnly; dist/manifest.json lists the 192, 512 and maskable PNGs with id and scope.
notes: registerType prompt, injectRegister false, manifest false (hand-edited file), no dev SW. Disagrees with X1-05 (injectManifest); push can later use workbox.importScripts. vite.config.js edit is one line in plugins; index.html also edited by R1 (theme-color), serialise.

title: Add the update-prompt UX: SW registration module, prompt component, flush-then-update flow with unit test
acceptance: node --test test/updateFlow.test.js passes (flush is awaited before updateServiceWorker, a failing flush still applies the update after the user confirms, no update call without confirmation); npm run build succeeds; src/main.jsx gains exactly one import of ./pwa/registerSW.js.
notes: Mounts its own React root so App.jsx is untouched. src/main.jsx is also edited by R1-01 (CSS imports), the router lane and X1-10, hence the dep on R1-01. Hourly registration.update() and on visibilitychange; skip registration on native platforms.

title: Add cache headers for sw.js, manifest, icons and hashed assets to vercel.json
acceptance: node --test test/vercelHeaders.test.js passes: /sw.js and /manifest.json get Cache-Control no-cache, /assets/* gets public, max-age=31536000, immutable, /icons/* gets a long max-age, and no header rule matches /api/*; node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('vercel.json','utf8'))" exits 0.
notes: vercel.json is created by R5-14 and extended by R5-15; chain R5-14, R7-06, R5-15. Header behaviour on Vercel itself is only verifiable on a preview deploy (R7-14).

title: Add Playwright config with the 5 blueprint device projects plus a pwa project, hermetic Supabase fixtures and a smoke spec
acceptance: npm run test:e2e passes on projects iphone-14, ipad-portrait, ipad-landscape, ipad-split-third and desktop-chrome using the preinstalled Chromium; smoke.spec.js asserts the app boots signed in with seeded kv_store rows, the tab bar renders, no pageerror, and zero unfulfilled non-localhost requests; viewports are 390x844, 834x1194, 1194x834, 375x1024 and 1440x900.
notes: browserName chromium for every project (only Chromium is installed here); register the block-external route first because Playwright matches last-registered routes first. Dummy env lives in .env.e2e (VITE_SUPABASE_URL=https://e2e.supabase.co). .gitignore gets dist-e2e, test-results and playwright-report. The pwa project defines testMatch for e2e/pwa.spec.js so R7-09 needs no config edit.

title: Write device-matrix layout specs from the blueprint verification table
acceptance: npm run test:e2e -- e2e/matrix passes on all 5 projects: phone shows 6 bottom tabs with no horizontal scroll; 834 wide shows the rail and hides tabs, with targets >= 44px and no sticky hover; 1194 wide shows sidebar and inspector per the hybrid decision, and rotating mid-session keeps the selected item; 375x1024 falls back to the phone shell; 1440x900 opens the palette with Ctrl+K and shows a focus ring on Tab.
notes: Needs the shell wired into App.jsx (R1-09) and ideally R1-10 merged. Safe-area assertion is arithmetic on the CSS variable only; emulation reports insets as 0.

title: Add PWA offline E2E spec: SW registers, offline reload works, /api and /dsa are not hijacked
acceptance: npm run test:e2e -- --project=pwa passes: navigator.serviceWorker.ready resolves; after context.setOffline(true) a reload still renders the shell; a navigation to /api/ics?title=a&start=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z returns text/calendar, not index.html; /dsa/mastery-map.html is not answered with the app shell.
notes: Only the pwa project allows service workers; all matrix projects block them.

title: Add a bundle-size budget script, budgets file and unit test
acceptance: npm run build && npm run size exits 0 and prints per-chunk and total gzip sizes (baseline JS total 237,168 B); node --test test/bundleBudget.test.js passes for the pure evaluate function including an over-budget failure case; budgets seeded as entry JS 135 kB, Life 62 kB, total JS 270 kB, CSS 12 kB gzip.
notes: Uses node:zlib gzipSync, which matches Vite's reported gzip exactly. Chunks matched by hash-stripped prefix. Re-baseline at the P0 gate.

title: Add an ESLint flat config limited to correctness rules and the two React hooks rules
acceptance: npm run lint exits 0 on the current tree (warnings allowed, errors none); it reports rules-of-hooks as error and exhaustive-deps as warn; the existing 6 eslint-disable comments resolve to a known rule.
notes: No source edits: the 3 known unused-var warnings (Agents.jsx:22-23, lifeLogic.test.js:12) stay as warnings so no other lane's files are touched. No Prettier, no TypeScript, no Husky.

title: Add the GitHub Actions CI workflow (check and e2e jobs) and Dependabot config
acceptance: A pull request run on GitHub shows jobs check (npm ci, lint, test, build, check-sw, size, informational audit) and e2e (playwright install chromium, test:e2e, report artifact on failure) both green, with the npm and Playwright browser caches hit on the second run.
notes: Node 22; concurrency cancel-in-progress; permissions contents read. Needs a GitHub-hosted repo (R7-14). Cannot be run locally; verified on first PR.

title: Document the CI, E2E, PWA update and preview-deploy workflow in the README
acceptance: README has sections for npm run lint, test, test:e2e, size, icons, the Vercel preview and env-var list (including OWNER_USER_ID), and how the in-app update prompt behaves; every command named exists in package.json (grep each script name).
notes: README.md is also edited by R5-18; this task goes after it.

title: USER: connect the repo to GitHub Actions and Vercel, set env vars per scope, enable required checks
acceptance: A pull request shows the Vercel preview check and the CI checks check and e2e; the default branch requires both; Vercel Production and Preview have VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, OWNER_USER_ID (and optional GROQ_MODEL) set, Node 22.x selected, and the preview URL loads the app and /sw.js returns Cache-Control no-cache.
notes: User decision inside: whether Preview uses a separate Supabase project, since previews otherwise write to real kv_store rows.

title: USER: verify install, offline and update prompt on a real iPhone and iPad
acceptance: On a deployed preview: Add to Home Screen shows the flame icon and standalone launch; airplane-mode launch shows the shell and local data; after deploying a second build the Update available prompt appears and Reload applies it without losing a just-typed task; FAB and tab bar clear the home indicator in portrait and landscape.
notes: Covers what Chromium emulation cannot: real safe-area insets, dvh, iOS SW lifecycle and storage isolation.
